what: cohort projection rule run forward from observed 2019, compared against observed 2020-2022 (ONEI 3.3)
horizon: three years, matching 2023->2025 past the 2022 anchor

finding.direction: the rule OVERSHOOTS the 60+ count at every horizon, and the error grows monotonically
finding.effect_on_headline: excess = D*Dfac - E, so an overshooting E makes the reported excess too SMALL. The 2025 headline is conservative on this axis by roughly the death figures above.
finding.why_the_noise_term_does_not_cover_it: projection error entered as a symmetric N(0, 1.5%) draw, which has zero mean and cannot represent a one-sided bias.
